offering_final_expenses_desc: A life insurance product designed to cover funeral costs, burial expenses, and other end-of-life financial obligations. Give your family peace of mind during difficult times.

privacy_intro_text: Welcome to aborgia.com. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect the personal information of our users. By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this policy. We are committed to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring transparency in how we handle your data.
privacy_info_types_intro: We may collect the following types of personal information when you interact with our website or services:
privacy_methods_intro: We collect personal information through the following methods:
privacy_methods_1: Contact and quote request forms submitted on our website
privacy_methods_3: Direct communication via email, phone, or social media
privacy_methods_4: Analytics tools that monitor website usage and performance
privacy_purpose_intro: We collect and process your personal information for the following purposes:
privacy_purpose_1: Providing insurance quotes and policy recommendations
privacy_purpose_2: Communicating with you about your inquiries and policies
privacy_purpose_3: Personalizing your experience and improving our services
privacy_purpose_4: Marketing and promotional communications (with your consent)
privacy_purpose_5: Complying with legal and regulatory obligations
privacy_legal_intro: We process personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds:
privacy_legal_2: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps
privacy_legal_4: Our legitimate business interests (balanced against your rights)
privacy_sharing_intro: We respect your privacy and do not sell your personal information. We may share your data with:
privacy_sharing_1: Insurance carriers and underwriters to provide quotes and policies
privacy_sharing_2: Third-party service providers who assist in our business operations
privacy_sharing_3: Analytics and marketing platforms to improve our services
privacy_sharing_4: Legal and regulatory authorities when required by law
privacy_cookies_intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. These technologies help us:
privacy_cookies_1: Analyze website traffic and usage patterns
privacy_cookies_4: Measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns
privacy_cookies_outro: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.
privacy_rights_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy_rights_1: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy_rights_2: Correction — request that we correct inaccurate or incomplete information
privacy_rights_3: Deletion — request that we delete your personal data
privacy_rights_4: Restriction — request that we limit the processing of your data
privacy_rights_5: Objection — object to our processing of your personal data
privacy_rights_6: Portability — request a transfer of your data to another service
privacy_rights_7: Withdrawal — withdraw your consent at any time
privacy_rights_outro: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.
privacy_security_intro: We take the security of your personal information seriously. We implement industry-standard measures to protect your data, including:
privacy_security_1: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
privacy_security_3: Regular security assessments and vulnerability testing
privacy_security_4: Employee training on data protection best practices
privacy_retention_text: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, to comply with legal obligations, to resolve disputes, and to enforce our agreements. When your data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it.
privacy_children_text: Our services are not intended for children under the age of 14. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected data from a child, please contact us immediately so we can take appropriate action to delete the information.
privacy_updates_text: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, or legal requirements. We will post any changes on this page and update the "Last updated" date at the top. Your continued use of our website and services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy. We encourage you to review this page regularly.
privacy_contact_intro: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal data, please reach out to us:

consent_intro_1: I, {name}, give my permission to Arelys Borgia to serve as the health insurance agent or broker for myself and my entire household if applicable, for purposes of enrollment in a Qualified Health Plan offered on the Federally Facilitated Marketplace. By consenting to this agreement, I authorize the above-mentioned Agent to view and use the confidential information provided by me in writing, electronically, or by telephone only for the purposes of one or more of the following:
consent_purpose_1: Searching for an existing Marketplace application;
consent_purpose_2: Completing an application for eligibility and enrollment in a Marketplace Qualified Health Plan or other government insurance affordability programs, such as Medicaid and CHIP or advance tax credits to help pay for Marketplace premiums;
consent_purpose_3: Providing ongoing account maintenance and enrollment assistance, as necessary;
consent_purpose_4: Responding to inquiries from the Marketplace regarding my Marketplace application.
consent_privacy_text: I understand that the Agent will not use or share my personally identifiable information (PII) for any purposes other than those listed above. The Agent will ensure that my PII is kept private and safe when collecting, storing, and using my PII for the stated purposes above.
consent_revoke_part1: I confirm that the information I provide for entry on my Marketplace eligibility and enrollment application will be true to the best of my knowledge. I understand that I do not have to share additional personal information about myself or my health with my Agent beyond what is required on the application for eligibility and enrollment purposes.
